dose_candidate_overlay.policy: dose_candidates are searchable evidence snippets, not final overdose thresholds. dose_rules remain the alerting layer.

online_library.local_policy: Local app storage remains local-first; this online library is queried only when remote fallback is enabled or when a review/import tool explicitly downloads the package.

overdose_warning_overlay.policy: dose_candidates are searchable evidence snippets, not final overdose thresholds. dose_rules remain the alerting layer.

privacy_note: Static API only receives HTTP requests for the files the client fetches. Enable remote fallback only if sending search terms/IDs to the configured host is acceptable.
warning: Prototype data. Do not use as clinical decision support without source review and validation.
